C-RELEASE-BETA-CHECKS-GATE.IntentSummary: Give release.yml's prerelease lane a lightweight fail-closed required-checks gate: authorize-tag (which already holds checks: read) collects check runs for the tag's HEAD SHA — the seal, never the payload train field — using the stable lane's exact collection shape (paginated check-runs API, sorted by started time, grouped per name+app keeping the latest attempt, one checks file), then a new prerelease-only gate step requires the two main required contexts pinned explicitly in the workflow source — "status check" and "release/governance" (GitHub Actions), derived from .github/release-governance.json rulesets.main.requiredChecks minus release/readiness, which is this very job's tag-time check and cannot pre-exist on the beta commit — to exist exactly once at that SHA with conclusion success before the release-signing environment or any packaging job runs; a failed, cancelled, or missing check, a match at any other SHA, or an ambiguous identity rejects the tag, and publish stays protected transitively (build requires authorize-tag success, publish requires build). The stable lane keeps byte-identical behavior for non-hyphenated tags, the lane gains no new job, artifact, permission, secret, environment or dependency, re-runs re-collect fresh evidence with no cross-run state, and source-pinned structural tests with deterministic red fixtures (failure, cancelled, missing, stale SHA, superseded rerun) plus a red control for the absent gate or list pin the whole contract; docs/release-process.md section 4a documents the owner-facing fail-closed semantics: promote before main CI is green and the tag run is rejected until a re-run sees the commit green.

T-001.Title: Prerelease checks-gate in authorize-tag: seal-keyed collection reusing the stable jq shape plus the fail-closed pinned-set gate

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add a prerelease-only collection step to authorize-tag, placed strictly after "install locked dependencies without lifecycle scripts" and strictly before the stable "read exact payload check runs" step, carrying exactly if: steps.identity.outputs.prerelease == 'true'. Its env takes GH_TOKEN from github.token and SEAL from steps.identity.outputs.seal, and its run block — set -euo pipefail retained — pipes gh api --paginate --slurp over repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$SEAL/check-runs?per_page=100 through the byte-identical stable jq shape ([.[].check_runs[]] | sort_by(.started_at) | group_by(.name + "|" + .app.name) | map(last | {name, app:.app.name, sha:.head_sha, conclusion})) into /tmp/release-checks.json. A preceding comment records that the collection keys on the tag's HEAD SHA (the seal) and never on the train payload field, that the jq shape's sort-then-group-keeping-last resolution is what makes a superseded earlier attempt (a flaky red re-run) resolve to the latest attempt, and that no artifact, cache or cross-run state exists on this path — a re-run re-collects fresh evidence. The checks-file JSON shape is identical to the stable lane's (same jq, same fields name/app/sha/conclusion, same path); the stable collection step itself keeps its exact bytes including its != 'true' condition.

Add the prerelease-only gate step immediately after the collection step, carrying exactly if: steps.identity.outputs.prerelease == 'true', with an env block holding SEAL from steps.identity.outputs.seal and PRERELEASE_REQUIRED_CHECKS pinned to exactly the compact JSON list [{"name":"status check","app":"GitHub Actions"},{"name":"release/governance","app":"GitHub Actions"}]. The env is preceded by a comment recording the derivation source (.github/release-governance.json rulesets.main.requiredChecks), why the list is pinned in the workflow source rather than read from the config (so the gate cannot silently drift with a config edit), and the release/readiness exclusion with its deadlock rationale: it is the tag-time check of this very workflow and cannot pre-exist on the beta commit — the comment names release/readiness unquoted so the file never contains the quoted form that would add it to the pinned set. The run block evaluates fail-closed through the job's already-set-up Node 22 (no npm dependency, no new tool): load /tmp/release-checks.json, then for each required identity (name + app) require exactly one match — zero matches is a missing required check, more than one an ambiguous identity — require the match's sha to equal SEAL (a match recorded at any other SHA is stale and fails), and require conclusion to be exactly success (failure, cancelled, and every other non-success conclusion fail); every rejection emits a ::error:: line prefixed [ReleaseAuthorize][authorize-tag][BLOCK_PRERELEASE_CHECKS_NOT_GREEN] naming the offending identity and reason, and the script exits nonzero without any status-swallowing construct around the evaluation. The gate runs no release:readiness, release:materials or release:preflight invocation, uploads no artifact (the release-identity artifact stays stable-only), and the step must not swallow its evaluation's exit status.

Keep every other byte of behavior: no new job anywhere in the file (the string checks-gate: never appears — the gate lives inside authorize-tag), no change to the job-level permissions (authorize-tag keeps exactly contents: read and checks: read, both already sufficient for the check-runs read), no change to triggers, concurrency, the workflow-level permissions block, the manual-build/build/prepare-publication/publish/publish-cask jobs, the build-side prerelease skips (if: needs.authorize-tag.outputs.prerelease != 'true'), the publish prerelease branch or the cask skip. Synchronize the file-local GRACE markup: VERSION 3.7.0 to 3.8.0; the MODULE_MAP authorize-tag entry gains a C-RELEASE-BETA-CHECKS-GATE sentence (prerelease tags additionally collect check runs at the seal and require the pinned main set green before any signing lane runs); a dated 2026-11-21 CHANGE_SUMMARY entry names C-RELEASE-BETA-CHECKS-GATE and the added prerelease boundary; MODULE_CONTRACT and all other markup stay as-is.

T-002.Title: Structural tests: positive gate pins, deterministic fail-closed fixture matrix with rerun supersession, and in-memory red controls

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Extend tests/renderer/release-governance.test.js inside START_BLOCK_RELEASE_GOVERNANCE_TESTS, keeping every existing test unweakened: an authorize-tag job slice and prerelease collection/gate step slices are derived by the file's existing split style, and positive pins assert both new steps carry the prerelease-only condition if: steps.identity.outputs.prerelease == 'true'; the collection step hits commits/$SEAL/check-runs (seal-keyed, no $PAYLOAD reference in either prerelease step), reuses the exact stable jq shape and writes /tmp/release-checks.json; the gate step carries PRERELEASE_REQUIRED_CHECKS whose pinned list contains exactly the two required identities status check and release/governance (both app GitHub Actions) and no third entry; the comment records the rulesets.main.requiredChecks derivation and the release/readiness exclusion rationale; the BLOCK_PRERELEASE_CHECKS_NOT_GREEN marker is present; collection orders before gate; the authorize-tag slice still contains the four stable != 'true' step conditions, the strict-admission run line and the release-identity artifact (stable lane byte-identical), and no new job key appears. The existing stable-lane pins elsewhere in the file keep passing.

Add a pure in-test validator assertPrereleaseChecksGate(checks, required, seal) mirroring the gate's evaluation (exactly-one match per name+app, sha equals seal, conclusion exactly success, otherwise reject with the identity and reason) and drive it with deterministic fixture JSON: a status check conclusion failure is rejected; status check cancelled is rejected; a required name absent from the collection is rejected; both checks success but recorded at a stale SHA is rejected; both checks success at the exact seal SHA passes; and a fixture carrying a superseded earlier attempt (same name+app, older started_at, red conclusion) plus a later success resolves to the latest attempt through the same sort-by-started-time, group-by-name-and-app, keep-last shape and passes. Add red controls that mutate only the checked-in workflow source string in memory (no tracked-file edits, no network) and reject each mutation with a distinct expectation: removing the PRERELEASE_REQUIRED_CHECKS env from the gate step is rejected as a missing pinned list; removing the gate step is rejected as a missing gate; stripping the gate's condition or flipping it to != 'true' is rejected as a gate that is not prerelease-only. Test comments note, in the gitleaks digest-pin stance, that shape pins cannot distinguish the pinned list from some other well-formed set — set truth is anchored by the reviewed diff plus the recorded rulesets.main.requiredChecks derivation, never by a runtime fetch.

Synchronize the test file's local markup: VERSION 2.2.0 to 2.3.0 and a dated 2026-11-21 CHANGE_SUMMARY entry for C-RELEASE-BETA-CHECKS-GATE; no changes to tests/renderer/action-ref-check.test.js, any tools/*.mjs helper, test configuration or other test file.
